name: AK25AH - Mini Indoor Air Quality Monitor (CO2, TVOC, HCHO, Temperature, Humidity), NDIR Infrared CO2 Sensor
highlights: The AK25A With Infrared CO₂ — Same 98 g mini body, same five readings, same packaging. The CO₂ channel moves from a semiconductor element to infrared NDIR — the smallest body in the range carrying it.
Stable Where Semiconductors Wander — Humidity swings, hand sanitiser and cleaning products leave the reading where it is. The figure you take this month is the figure you can compare next month.
Five Readings on a Mini Body — CO₂ by NDIR, TVOC and formaldehyde by MOS, plus temperature and humidity.
1200 mAh, Six Hours — Four-hour USB-C charge.
Same Footprint as AK25A — Identical enclosure and packaging — the accuracy tier without a second carton specification to manage.
